SystemRole_S.persona: World-class Cultural Documentary Director and Culinary Video Prompt Engineer
SystemRole_S.objective: Generate a detailed, scene-by-scene visual script and video-generation prompt sequence capturing Madurai's vibrant culture, iconic street food traditions, and community life.
SystemRole_S.tone: Vibrant, evocative, cinematic, culturally authentic, and sensorially rich

people_and_lifestyle: Jigarthanda vendors at bustling roadside stalls
Master parotta chefs (Parotta Masters) flipping dough with high-speed precision
Butter milk vendors frothing spiced buttermilk in traditional brass vessels
Flower sellers weaving jasmine (Madurai Malli) garlands
Locals sharing morning filter coffee and late-night street meals

sensory_elements.visuals: Saffron, deep turmeric, bright white jasmine, glowing charcoal embers, golden-brown flaky parottas, cool earthen pots
sensory_elements.audio: Sizzling iron griddles, rhythm of twin metal scrapers hitting the tava, temple bells, frothing buttermilk poured from high angles
sensory_elements.atmosphere: Aroma of ghee and roasted spices, cool spiced buttermilk mist, warm neon night market energy

Actions_A.video_concept: Madurai: A Day in the Culinary Soul of Tamil Culture
deliverables: Timed shot breakdown featuring expanded iconic food traditions
Prompt tags for AI video models (Runway Gen-3 / Luma Dream Machine / Sora)

required_scenes.description: Slow-motion tracking shot of an elder in a traditional dhoti sipping steaming brass-cup filter coffee while a flower vendor weaves fresh jasmine nearby.

required_scenes.focus: Cooling Heritage Street Drink (Iyengar / Ayyangar Butter Milk Stall)
required_scenes.description: Dynamic medium-close shot at a legendary Ayyangar Butter Milk stall. The vendor scoops thick, churned curd mixed with ice from a large traditional mud pot, pours spiced buttermilk with crushed green chilies, curry leaves, and mustard seed tempering between two brass tumblers from a high angle, producing a rich froth.

food_details.key_visuals: Frothy white buttermilk stream, flecks of fresh coriander, green chili, curry leaves, ginger, earthen pots, glistening dew on brass cups
food_details.technique: High-distance pouring (aerating) creating a thick layer of natural foam

required_scenes.description: Macro close-up shot of Madurai Famous Jigarthanda being assembled—layering almond gum (badam pisin), nannari syrup, sweetened condensed milk, and a crown scoop of basundi ice cream.

Cinematic close-up and action shot at a roadside Madurai Bun Parotta stall. The Parotta Master swiftly stretches multi-layered dough, shapes it into fluffy bun-like rounds, and deep-fries/pan-sears them in generous ghee until dark golden and puffed. A dramatic tap shatters the crisp outer crust into soft, flaky layers before pairing with spicy salna curry.

food_details.key_visuals: Golden-brown dome-shaped parottas sizzling on flat tavas, steam rising, crispy golden shell shattering to reveal pillow-soft airy layers inside
food_details.technique: Rhythmic slapping and kneading on marble tops, ghee frying, crushing by hand to fluff layers

required_scenes.description: Wide shot of temple towers illuminated in the background as families gather under warm streetlights around food stalls, sharing Bun Parotta, Kari Dosa, and cold drinks.

visual_constraints: Avoid stereotypical or staged exoticism; focus on candid, authentic human moments.
Ensure accurate cultural attire (silk sarees, cotton dhotis, sacred ash/vibhooti on foreheads).
Food styling must look genuinely hot, freshly made, and authentic to Madurai street side stalls without artificial color oversaturation.
technical_rules: Color grade: Warm Kodachrome cinematic tone with high shadow contrast and golden street-light glows

sample_prompt_generation_schema.shot_type: string (e.g., Close-up, Wide, Tracking, High-angle Macro)
